info.name: MaintainX Parts API
info.description:
REST API V1

Support: support@getmaintainx.com | https://www.getmaintainx.com/

This is the MaintainX REST API reference. It provides detailed documentation for endpoints, request parameters, response schemas, and error codes available.

For setup guides, authentication walkthroughs, how-tos, etc., see the Build With MaintainX guide.

What's in this reference:

Full endpoint listings across all MaintainX entities (Work Orders, Assets, Parts, Locations, Users, and more)

Request and response schemas with field-level detail

Query parameters, filters, and pagination behavior

Authentication requirements and error codes

Subscriptions and webhooks for event-driven integrations

Base URL: https://api.getmaintainx.com/v1

All requests must be authenticated with a Bearer token (see Settings > Integrations > API Keys to generate a key).

API access is available on Premium and Enterprise plans.

Contact Support:
 Name: Support
 Email: support@getmaintainx.com
